name: Care Worldly
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than being consumed by worldly anxieties about daily needs. Jeremiah emphasizes the blessedness of those who place their hope in God, likening them to trees firmly rooted and flourishing even in drought. Jesus reinforces this by instructing His followers not to worry about food, drink, or clothing, reminding them that God cares for His creation and that anxious thought cannot add to one's life. Together, these verses call believers to a Christ-centered confidence that God provides and sustains, freeing them from care worldly concerns.
